levels.surface: عبد الله بن إبراهيم بن قارظ

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): saying 1 is Abu Huraira's report of the prayer in the Prophet's mosque; saying 2 is the Prophet's words on the last prophet and last mosque, which Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qaretz attests from Abu Huraira.
The second route's narrators (Abu Salama and Abu Abd Allah, who tell the story) are read as shared with the first; this is a judgment about the story structure.
مولى الجهنيين and وكان من أصحاب أبي هريرة are a description and an editor gloss, left out.
The comma in محمد بن، حرب is in the text and kept as written.
